summary: FLAMESIM is an data-analysis platform built to prevent microgravity fires in space exploration. It enables aerospace engineers to instantly compare material flammability under varying oxygen and cabin conditions, turning decades of unorganized data into rapid, life-saving decisions.
details:
FLAMESIM is a centralized platform designed by a team from the Universitat Politècnica de Valencia for the NASA Space Apps Challenge to optimize material selection and prevent microgravity fires. Inspired by the Apollo 1 disaster, it solves the bottleneck of unorganized data from decades of NASA experiments (FLEX, Saffire, SLICE) by integrating 1,154 verified tests across 38 materials from the NASA PSI repository.

The application allows engineers to simulate material behavior, oxygen concentrations, and ventilation flows in three simple steps. It delivers high technical, economic, and operational feasibility by providing traceable, auditable data that drastically cuts down the high costs and slow processes of physical space testing, ensuring safer future missions beyond Earth.
